threads.body: [General] This direct assertion bypasses the standard `InstrumentationTestRunner.waitAndAssertTraces` path, which also validates instrumentation scope versions and records emitted spans when `collectMetadata` is enabled (`testing-common/.../InstrumentationTestRunner.java:155-165`). As a result, all four stable Vert.x test paths migrated to this helper silently lose those checks and metadata. Please add trace-filtering support to the standard runner/extension and use it here, or otherwise preserve both hooks.

Addressed in 2f3446729384c20fd7f3a5fbe8c2b15f92438f28.

Analysis: The Vert.x helper reimplemented waiting, filtering, sorting, and assertion outside InstrumentationTestRunner, so it omitted scope-version validation and metadata collection. Add filtered sorted-trace overloads to the runner and JUnit extension, keep hooks applied to all captured traces, and filter only the traces passed to the ordered assertion.

Upsides: Stable Vert.x assertions can ignore incidental poll traces without bypassing standard waiting, scope-version validation, or metadata collection, and future tests can reuse the same supported path.

Downsides: Adds two overloads to the internal testing API and one extra filtered list allocation when filtering is requested.
